title: Fix Admin Button Flash/Disappear on Live

requirements.summary: Add hardcoded admin principal fallback in Navigation component to prevent button flash
acceptanceCriteria: The Admin navigation link does not flash or disappear on page load for the admin principal.
A hardcoded fallback principal check is implemented in the Navigation component so that the known admin principal always sees the Admin link.
The fallback is applied even when `isCallerAdmin` backend call is still loading or returns an error.

file_operations.description: Add a hardcoded admin principal constant at the top of the file (clearly commented as a temporary fallback). Modify the admin link visibility logic to check if the current identity's principal matches the hardcoded admin principal as a fallback. If the principal matches, show the Admin link regardless of the backend `isCallerAdmin` result. Keep the existing backend call but treat the hardcoded check as a safety net. Ensure the fallback is applied when the backend call is loading, errors, or returns false for the known admin principal.

requirements.summary: Suppress loading-then-false flash in admin status hooks by holding indeterminate state
acceptanceCriteria: The Admin button/link is not rendered at all (neither shown nor hidden) while the admin status check is still loading.
The Admin button only disappears if the backend definitively returns `false` for `isCallerAdmin` after the call resolves.
No flash of the Admin button followed by its removal occurs for non-admin users.

file_operations.description: Modify the hook to return an explicit loading state that remains true until the backend call resolves or errors. Do not allow isAdmin to become false during the initial load phase. Only set isAdmin to false after the query has completed (isFetched is true) and the backend returned false. Ensure the hook distinguishes between 'still loading' and 'definitely not admin'.

Refactor the phase state machine to hold an indeterminate/loading state longer. Do not transition to a 'not admin' phase while the backend call is pending or during actor initialization. Only mark the user as non-admin after a definitive backend response or timeout. Ensure the hook returns a clear loading flag that the Navigation component can use to avoid rendering the Admin button prematurely.

Update the admin link rendering logic to check both the loading state and the isAdmin result. Do not render the Admin link at all (not even as hidden) while loading is true. Only render it when loading is false and either isAdmin is true or the hardcoded principal fallback matches. This prevents any flash of the button during the loading phase.
